## What's new in 0.1.10

- **Simplified Chinese.** Choose 简体中文 under **Settings → More → Language**. Thanks to
  [HeliusHao](https://github.com/HeliusHao) for the translation in [PR #5](https://github.com/atabits/fern/pull/5).
  This release also translates sticky note settings, Focus automation and stopwatch dialogs, and
  corrects labels for empty lists, countdowns, and smart list visibility.
- **Chinese dates and holidays.** Numeric dates default to year/month/day. Calendar headings and
  task dates use Chinese date labels, and 12-hour times display 上午 or 下午. The manual time field
  accepts both. The holiday shortcut adds a mainland China calendar. Quick Add examples now use
  supported syntax. For dates in Quick Add, use numeric dates or English or Russian keywords.
- **Smart filters.** Use Normal or Advanced mode to filter by list, tag, date, priority, keyword,
  or task type. Advanced mode supports AND, OR, NOT, and repeated conditions. Start with a built-in
  example, then preview matching tasks before saving. New date rules cover recurring tasks, the
  next N days, and custom ranges. Existing filters are kept. Older clients can keep syncing tasks
  and other data, but show an empty result for filters saved with the new rules.
- **Task shortcuts.** Delete still removes the selected task. Backspace edits text in input fields
  and no longer removes tasks ([#6](https://github.com/atabits/fern/issues/6)).
- **Markdown preview.** Empty lines between list items stay visible in task descriptions
  ([#7](https://github.com/atabits/fern/issues/7)).
- **Settings.** The navigation sidebar is wider so longer labels fit.
- **Release builds.** Packages are built on demand and reviewed in a draft release before publication.
